receipts.testNamePattern: ^a failed gate run keeps its diagnostics after the checkout is removed$
receipts.detail: push-gate-corpus-worktree.js --gate <sha> --run <failing command>: the receipt and the first failing command's artifact are kept in test-output/push-gate/<sha>/, the checkout is gone, and the gate prints where it kept them

receipts.testNamePattern: ^a gate whose injection link was replaced keeps its diagnostics$
receipts.detail: the GATE_LINKS_BROKEN return (exit 1 after a passing command) retains like a failed run

receipts.testNamePattern: ^a gate that dirtied its checkout keeps its diagnostics$
receipts.detail: the GATE_DIRTY return (exit 1 after a passing command) retains like a failed run

receipts.testNamePattern: ^names exactly the failing test files of the failing command$
receipts.detail: renderRunSummary reads the failing command's captured artifact: file-level verdict lines only (nested TAP not ok N lines and lookalikes ignored), lab-relayed [host] lines read, the last verdict decides

receipts.testNamePattern: ^does not name a file that passed its retried-once rerun$
receipts.detail: a # retried-once pass makes the file green; a retried-once fail stays named

receipts.testNamePattern: ^reports an absent runner summary line as incomplete, never as a count$
receipts.detail: no # test-files line: the summary prints 'summary line absent - list may be incomplete' and no count

receipts.testNamePattern: ^bounds the failing-file list and counts what it withheld$
receipts.detail: 27 failing files: 20 named, 7 withheld and counted
